title: Spotlight full-bleed restore
summary: Explore spotlight again extends to the right screen edge and behind the sidebar with content-centered imagery.
changes: Spotlight shell width is content plus sidebar so the hero reaches both screen edges.
Backdrop crop aligns with the main content column instead of the page center.
Layout overflow no longer clips the bleed on desktop.

title: Explore favorites and collapsed sidebar
summary: Favorites appear on Explore for signed-in users, and the desktop sidebar starts collapsed by default.
changes: Added a Favorites rail on Explore below Watch later.
Favorites update when you star or unstar titles without leaving the page.
Desktop sidebar now defaults to collapsed; your choice is still saved in a cookie.

title: Spotlight preference ranking
summary: The Explore spotlight carousel now uses the same genre and region ranking as Popular rails.
changes: Spotlight slides are ranked globally by genre fit and region priority instead of alternating movies and TV.
US English productions can appear ahead of UK titles in the hero carousel when English is selected.
Guests still see the default movie/TV interleaved spotlight.

title: English region ranking
summary: When English is selected, US productions rank above UK and other English regions in personalized rails.
changes: English region priority: US, then UK, then Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and Ireland.
Co-productions use their highest-priority matching country for ranking.
Genre ranking still applies first; region order breaks ties within the same genre tier.

title: Softer genre ranking
summary: Titles with extra genres you did not pick can still appear, but they rank below perfect genre matches in personalized rails.
changes: A Drama + Documentary title still shows when you picked Drama, but pure Drama picks appear higher in Popular and personalized lists.
Titles with no overlap on your selected genres are still excluded.
Language and region filtering stay strict.

title: Fix preferences being wiped on sign-in
summary: Stopped the login sync from overwriting saved taste preferences with empty local data.
changes: Sign-in sync no longer sends or overwrites profile preferences; only watch later and playback progress sync from local storage.
Skipping or dismissing onboarding keeps your existing saved preferences instead of replacing them with an empty draft.
Preference save failures now surface an error instead of failing silently.

title: Account-synced preferences
summary: Taste preferences are stored on your Supabase profile and follow you across devices, not localStorage.
changes: Signed-in users always load and save preferences from their account profile.
Personalized Explore, category, and genre APIs read preferences from the server session instead of stale client payloads.
Legacy guest localStorage preferences migrate into your account on sign-in when your profile is still empty.

title: Language and region preference filtering
summary: Language picks now also filter by production country, so unselected languages hide their home regions from personalized rails.
changes: Hindi not selected now excludes India (IN) titles from Popular and personalized Explore rails.
Korean, Japanese, Chinese, Tagalog, Thai, Vietnamese, and other language picks map to their primary production regions.
Region checks use origin_country, production_countries, and OMDb country metadata alongside language filters.

title: Looser genre matching
summary: Genre preferences now match when a title shares any of your picks, not only when every genre on the title is selected.
changes: A title tagged Drama and Documentary can appear when you picked Drama, even if you did not pick Documentary.
Language filtering stays strict so unselected languages like Hindi still do not slip through on bilingual titles.
Popular rails still skip the unfiltered TMDB fallback when you are signed in with preferences.

title: Stricter preference filtering
summary: Popular and personalized rails now respect your saved genres and languages, including bilingual titles and OMDb metadata.
changes: Popular movies and TV rails no longer fall back to unfiltered TMDB picks when you are signed in with preferences.
Genre matching requires every genre on a title to be in your selection, including OMDb genre strings on catalog rows.
Language matching checks every language on a title, not just the first, so Hindi and other unselected languages do not slip through on bilingual listings.
Mongo personalized queries match and exclude OMDb language strings, not only TMDB original_language codes.
Search popular rails use the same strict filters when your preferences are set.

title: Build log and cleaner guest mode
summary: Added a public build log and made guest browsing simpler by keeping preference setup account-only.
changes: Added a public /build-log page linked from the footer.
Moved build log content into a hand-curated JSON file so release notes can be written clearly instead of copied from commit messages.
Removed guest onboarding and guest preferences; recommendations only personalize after sign-in.
Hid the preferences card from guest profiles.

title: Production build fixes
summary: Cleaned up deploy-blocking issues after the account release went live.
changes: Removed TypeScript-only syntax from JavaScript API route files so Vercel can compile them.
Fixed hook dependency warnings in the movie watch page.
Kept the watch party controls stable across renders.

title: Accounts, synced data, and personalized Explore
summary: Shipped Supabase-backed accounts with synced user data and personalized browse rails.
changes: Added login and signup pages with a new auth poster collage.
Added account profile data, avatar upload, onboarding preferences, watch history, watch progress, watch later, and favorites sync.
Added the Activity page for Continue watching, Watch later, and Favorites.
Personalized Explore, genre pages, category pages, and search when signed-in preferences are available.
Added Supabase migrations for profiles, avatars, watch history, progress, watch later, and favorites.

title: Search and footer polish
summary: Tightened up search results and simplified the footer.
changes: Removed extra search result labels and captions for a cleaner results view.
Simplified footer copy and layout.
Kept unreleased anime out of browse rails.

title: Watch page refinements
summary: Improved watch page controls and related content rails.
changes: Replaced episode season tabs with a compact selector.
Hid unreleased episodes from the show episode picker.
Fixed You might like recommendations for movie and show pages by moving TMDB calls server-side.
Added high-rating filters for popular movie and TV recommendations.

title: Brand and layout refresh
summary: Updated the Teavie chrome, brand assets, and full-bleed Explore layout.
changes: Replaced legacy logos with cropped Teavie brand assets.
Moved the version chip into the sidebar and mobile drawer.
Reworked Explore spotlight and horizontal rails so they align with the sidebar and screen edge.
Smoothed sidebar collapse behavior for full-bleed rails.

title: Catalog browsing polish
summary: Improved browse pages, cards, genre pages, and content density.
changes: Polished search and category pages.
Moved catalog stats to the homepage.
Updated activity and profile rails to show seven cards across where space allows.
Matched card sizing across profile and activity rails.

title: Watch parties and player sync
summary: Added watch party support and persistent playback progress.
changes: Added watch party room creation and join controls.
Synced host playback state for supported movie and TV players.
Persisted movie and TV progress locally, with account sync added later.
Added sticky top navigation for player pages.

title: Anime rails and metadata cleanup
summary: Improved anime recommendations, related franchise rails, posters, and episode metadata.
changes: Made anime show rails load progressively and cache results.
Showed full anime franchises in Related rails.
Fixed empty Related and You might like anime rails after split-cour merges.
Improved anime poster and episode metadata handling.
